translation.ChessBaseGuide.Intro: ChessRiddle Studio reads PGN files. Export your ChessBase databases as PGN once, then add them here.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Selected: This file is a ChessBase database. ChessRiddle Studio cannot open it directly.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Step1: In ChessBase, create a new database and choose PGN as the file type.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Step2: Copy your games into it, for example by dragging your database onto the new one. ChessBase converts them to PGN.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Step3: In the Library, choose ‘{{importDatabase}}’, open ‘{{local}}’ and select your new .pgn file.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Tip1: Start with your own games and repertoires. They are small and matter most.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Tip2: A large reference database such as the Mega Database becomes a PGN file of several gigabytes and takes a while to import.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Tip3: Comments, variations, symbols and coloured arrows and squares come along. ChessBase-only data such as the player encyclopedia and some database metadata are not part of PGN.
translation.ChessBaseGuide.Title: Coming from ChessBase?

translation.Engines.Options.SkillLevel.Description: Makes the engine play weaker on purpose (0 = weakest, 20 = full strength). Only matters when it plays against you.

translation.Engines.Options.Syzygy50MoveRule.Descrip: Counts tablebase wins that need more than 50 moves as draws, as in real games.
translation.Engines.Options.Syzygy50MoveRule.Label: Respect the 50-move rule
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyPath.Description: Folders with Syzygy tablebases. With them the engine plays endgames with few pieces perfectly.
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyPath.Label: Endgame tablebase folders
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyProbeDepth.Descrip: Minimum search depth before the engine asks the tablebases. Raise it if they are on a slow drive.
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyProbeDepth.Label: Tablebase probe depth
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyProbeLimit.Descrip: The engine uses the tablebases only with at most this many pieces on the board.
translation.Engines.Options.SyzygyProbeLimit.Label: Tablebase piece limit
translation.Engines.Options.Threads.Description: How many processor cores the engine uses. More cores make analysis faster.
translation.Engines.Options.Threads.Label: CPU threads

translation.Engines.Options.UCI_Chess960.Label: Chess960

translation.Engines.Options.UCI_Elo.Label: Target Elo
